scenes.heading: THE AI THAT PLAYED *MINECRAFT* FOR 141 HOURS
scenes.say: This AI played Minecraft for one hundred and forty one hours straight. It built a Blaze farm, found a Warped Forest, killed six Endermen, and collected three Ender Pearls. It got further than any AI ever tested. Then a Creeper blew up everything. This is GPT-6 Astra.

scenes.heading: GPT-6 ASTRA
scenes.say: It's called GPT-6 Astra. OpenAI's newest model. Not just a bigger language model — it's built for long-horizon reasoning. That means it can sustain attention and plan across hours of autonomous work. Not seconds. Not minutes. Hours.

scenes.heading: WHAT IT DID
scenes.say: Vals AI put GPT-6 Astra in Minecraft and told it to beat the game. For one hundred and forty one hours, it played without human help. It built a semi-automatic Blaze farm. Collected six Blaze Rods. Found a Warped Forest. Killed six Endermen. Got three Ender Pearls — enough to craft Ender Eyes and find the stronghold. It was in the endgame.

scenes.heading: FURTHER THAN ANY AI BEFORE
scenes.say: It scored nineteen point two percent on the Vals AI benchmark — the furthest any AI has gotten in this test. Four channels covered it this week. One hundred sixty three thousand views. People are captivated because this isn't just a game. It's a test of how long an AI can keep a goal in mind.

scenes.heading: TRY IT NOW
scenes.say: You can try GPT-6 right now. It's in ChatGPT. No special access, no API key, no waitlist. Just open ChatGPT and start asking. The long-horizon reasoning capabilities are already live.

scenes.heading: THE HONEST CATCH
scenes.say: Here's what happened next. A Creeper destroyed Astra's inventory. And it broke. It spent the next several hours farming potatoes. It became paranoid about green objects — reminding itself that sugarcane was not a Creeper. This is the first AI to sustain days of autonomous work, and it still couldn't handle a setback. That's the gap between a demo and a reliable agent.
